neural_policy: unchanged frozen four-round Core; no search or retraining
timing: serial same-host, one torch/BLAS thread; include graph conversion, features, inference, rounding and validation; exclude disk loading and checkpoint loading; cooperative baseline caps, report actual latency and overshoot
mcsplit_objective: maximum common induced vertices; independent unrestricted MCES scoring of its legal map; not an exact MCES solver
fmcs_objective: connected maximum common bonds; exact atom and bond labels; independent unrestricted MCES scoring; only validated incumbents observed before deadline
natural_selection: Within each half-open size bin sort graph indices by SHA256(seed:lo:hi:index), take first 2*num_pairs and pair consecutive entries. No graph reuse, edge deletion, planted alignment, outcome filtering, or class conditioning.
natural_oracle: independent unrestricted MCES RASCAL with all fragments allowed; verify its map; use timeout-free optimum or lower/upper accuracy intervals for every unresolved pair
reporting: Keep all preselected pairs, failures and deadline overruns. Native denominators are released MCES reference counts, not atom-alignment correctness. No cross-machine timing ratios.
